verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents bulk operations, such as selecting many dashboards, alerts or other items and editing, moving or deleting them in one action. File-based provisioning and observability-as-code let you define dashboards and data sources declaratively, and alerts are managed from a consolidated view. These are adjacent configuration-management features, not a documented bulk-operation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
